info.title: Laranet.Cli
info.description: Command-line tool for generating Laranet application code.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Creates Laranet projects and generates application code from the command line.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --output
options.description: The directory where the project folder is created. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The root namespace. Derived from the project name by default.

options.name: --template
options.description: The project template: minimal-api (default), mvc, layered, hexagonal, modular, or console.

options.name: --layout
options.description: The project layout: project (default) or repository.

options.name: --sln
options.description: Creates a solution file in the project layout. [default: False]

options.name: --with-data
options.description: References the Laranet.Data package. [default: False]

options.name: --with-efcore
options.description: References the Laranet.EntityFrameworkCore package. [default: False]

options.name: --with-aspnetcore
options.description: References the Laranet.AspNetCore package. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Writes into an existing non-empty directory and overwrites generated files. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Shows the files that would be generated without writing them. [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Prompts for missing values and overwrite confirmation. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The project name, also used as the folder name.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Checks a project for deterministic dependency, version, and code hazards.

options.name: --path
options.description: The project or directory to inspect. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

options.name: --json
options.description: Writes the report as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Returns exit code 1 when warnings are found. [default: False]

options.name: --check-pagination
options.description: Enables the heuristic for unbounded endpoint queries. [default: False]

options.name: --check-controller-dbcontext
options.description: Enables the rule that checks DbContext usage in controllers. [default: False]

options.name: --check-dto-entities
options.description: Enables the heuristic for DTOs exposing entity types. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

options.name: --namespace

options.description: The base namespace for generated code. Inferred from the nearest project by default.

options.name: --profile
options.description: The CRUD profile: simple (default), standard, clean, or modular.

options.name: --context
options.description: The fully qualified DbContext type. Discovered from the nearest project by default.

options.name: --fields
options.description: The entity fields as Name:type pairs separated by commas. Defaults to Name:string.

options.name: --from-model
options.description: Requires an existing entity and generates the CRUD surface from its source. [default: False]

options.name: --scaffold
